Effects

Tiered Bonus: Cropier Crops 
Farming Wheat, Carrot, and Potatoes have a 0.00%➜0.03%➜0.04%➜0.05% chance of dropping a Cropie. Inside the Greenhouse gives a 2.0%➜12.0%➜16.0%➜20.0% chance to drop one from any crop grown inside. Grants +0➜10➜20➜30  Farming Fortune
Pieces Required: 2+

While wearing Tater Armor and collecting crops, there is a chance to harvest a Cropie when breaking Wheat, Carrot and Potato.

Trivia

  • The texture of the Tater Helmet might be a reference to Technoblade, who was known for the Great Potato War among many other things.
